note: Owner-chosen families and roles for the community-refinement pilot (issue #5). Only `include`, `exclude` and `max_file_bytes` may change to bring a family into the 50-250 entity range. `include` entries are repo-relative globs (non-recursive); a matching directory is copied recursively. `exclude` globs match repo-relative paths. `commit` pins the shallow clone. `license` is an SPDX identifier read from the named license file; NOASSERTION means the checkout carries no license file.

families.role: code and doc about the same responsibility
families.notes: Owner subtree unchanged; micro/ includes its tests and micro/README.md.

families.role: one topic with builder boilerplate hubs
families.notes: The package is one directory, so it is trimmed by file: the CSVFormat builder hub is kept with CSVPrinter, QuoteMode, DuplicateHeaderMode, CSVException and package-info. The parser/lexer/record side is excluded; references to it are dangling edges.

families.role: multiple legitimate topics in one package
families.notes: Nine top-level modules with distinct topics are kept: package init, configuration, JSON serialization (json/), logging, sessions, signals, templating, test client and class-based views. The app, blueprint, sansio, cli, ctx and helper machinery is excluded.

families.role: continuity with the recorded 6,685-entity baseline; cross-type
families.notes: Config persistence (InMemoryConfigDb, ModuleConfigJsonFile) and connection retry (RobustConnection*) are excluded; module lifecycle, registry, state, security and discovery are kept. This is a subset of the code behind the recorded 6,685-entity baseline, not a recapture of it.
The AsciiDoc sections directory under api/part1 is api/part1/standard/sections. Its five annex files are excluded and the 20 clause_* files are kept.

c_library_v2 has no README.md and no LICENSE file at this commit; nothing was substituted, and the licence needs an owner ruling before redistribution. Widened from minimal/ alone (47) to the minimal dialect include closure in the same repo: protocol.h, mavlink_types.h, mavlink_helpers.h, checksum.h, mavlink_conversions.h and mavlink_sha256.h (which carries its own KTH BSD-style header).

Only top-level server/*.js helper modules are kept. The *.spec.js tests, the page/ and data/ subdirectories, and the three largest modules (respond.js, remote-functions.js, sourcemaps.js) are excluded.

families.role: docs with multiple topics and boilerplate pages; isolated entities
families.notes: Rule-based subset, not hand-picked: every top-level docs/*.md under 3,000 bytes (25 pages). Iteration 1 used an under-5,000-byte rule (40 pages, 327 entities).
Root files only, narrowed to the deflate engine: deflate.c, deflate.h, trees.c, trees.h and the macro-heavy zutil.h. zconf.h (187 prefix macros) and the inflate, gz and checksum files are excluded.

families.role: client library sharing vocabulary with D3 but an independent subject
families.notes: The client API core is kept: __init__, api, sessions, models, adapters, auth, exceptions, structures, hooks and status_codes. utils, cookies, compat, typing, version and internal helpers are excluded.
Root non-test Go files minus the shell-completion generators (*completions*.go, active_help.go), plus README.md.
